digest.component_or_area: Plan review criterion T1 (overlay-priorart), model capability routing, Bedrock cutover
propositions: T1 (a blocking plan-review criterion) lost access to server-side web search after the Bedrock cutover because _anthropic_web_search_capabilities gated on resolved.startswith('anthropic'), which is false for bedrock: model names.
The web-access decision is based on provider-name prefix matching, violating the epic's zero-exceptions rule that capability decisions derive from registry membership, not string shape.
Web-search tool attachment is unobservable in signed verdicts; the silent withdrawal through the cutover had no audit trail and cannot be detected in plan-review output.

The original design's provider-side-only assumption (no rebar-side fetch tool) is incompatible with the requirement that web access hold for every provider; Bedrock lacks the native tool so a fallback mechanism is required.
T1's rubric incorrectly frames web access as optional and provider-dependent, contradicting the operator requirement that web grounding is guaranteed for T1 regardless of provider.
